items.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
items.summary: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.

items.title: OpenAI builds safety system that catches misuse without storing customer data
items.summary: OpenAI plans to offer its most advanced AI models to corporate customers without storing their data, while still detecting misuse. The article OpenAI builds safety system that catches misuse without storing customer data appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Researchers say OpenAI revoked their access to limited cyber program
items.summary: The idea behind OpenAI's Trusted Access for Cyber program is to give trusted defenders better models so they can report bugs and vulnerabilities to companies, with the aim of getting flaws patched faster.

items.title: Introducing AI Futures

items.title: Strengthening democratic oversight in national security
items.summary: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise.

items.title: Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities
items.summary: OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment, and security for frontier AI models. See how new safeguards are guiding the pace of model development.

items.title: Adobe Firefly adds AI audio tools and Google's Gemini Omni Flash
items.summary: Adobe is making three AI audio tools broadly available in Firefly. Generate Music, Generate Speech, and Generate Sound Effects create royalty-free music, voiceovers, and sound effects for video projects. Adobe has also added Gemini Omni Flash to the platform. The article Adobe Firefly adds AI audio tools and Google's Gemini Omni Flash appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Google packs Search and Gemini with new AI study tools
items.summary: The launch of the new study features marks Google's latest effort to make Gemini the AI assistant that students turn to when learning and studying, as it continues to compete with companies like OpenAI.

items.title: We still don’t know how people are really using AI
items.summary: AI companies like Anthropic and OpenAI regularly publish reports on how people are using products like Claude and ChatGPT, but they only release the data they want us to see, AI researchers say. “There is no independent source to corroborate it,” says Anka Reuel, a computer science PhD candidate at the Stanford Trustworthy AI Research…

items.title: China now has its own AI circular financing scheme
items.summary: Unitree Robotics rose 460 percent in its Shanghai IPO, hitting a valuation of around $50 billion. But an FT report shows much of the demand for its robots comes from state-backed training centers that buy the machines and sell the resulting data back to the manufacturers, a circular business model that echoes the Nvidia criticism in the US....
